units: Joules per token (linear form) or Joules per request (theta form). Server-side (IT) energy unless pue_included > 1.

tiers.A: Measured on hardware and published, but possibly for a different model than the audited one (use as counterfactual or proxy).
tiers.B: Published top-down estimate for the audited model; methodology assumptions dominate.
tiers.C: Unverified constant shipped in ThermDash; provenance missing or citation does not contain the value. Report, never headline.

thermdash_energy_json.label: ThermDash energy.json (gpt-4o-mini)
thermdash_energy_json.provenance: ThermDash/energy.json, entry gpt-4o-mini, measured:false, source tag luccioni2024 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16863). Value not traceable to a table in that paper.

thermdash_benchmarks_json.label: ThermDash energy_benchmarks.json (gpt-4o-mini)
thermdash_benchmarks_json.provenance: ThermDash/token_dashboard/data/energy_benchmarks.json cites arXiv:2407.21783, which is 'The Llama 3 Herd of Models' (https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.21783) and reports no GPT-4o-mini energy.

thermdash_ecologits_fallback.label: ThermDash ecologits_bridge default rate
thermdash_ecologits_fallback.provenance: ThermDash/token_dashboard/ecologits_bridge.py ENERGY_RATES['default'] = (0.0008, 0.0030) kWh per 1k tokens; gpt-4o-mini falls through to 'default'. No citation.

jegham2025_topdown.label: Jegham et al. 2025 top-down fit (GPT-4o mini, DGX A100)
jegham2025_topdown.provenance: Exact 3-point linear fit E = a*n_in + b*n_out + c to the GPT-4o mini row of 'How Hungry is AI?' (https://arxiv.org/html/2505.09598); values include PUE 1.12, divided out before use.

cavagna2026_llama31_8b_h100.label: Cavagna et al. 2026 theta-model (Llama 3.1 8B, H100, batched TensorRT-LLM)
cavagna2026_llama31_8b_h100.theta_terms: E_tot = t0*n_out + t1*n_in^2 + t2*n_in*n_out + t3*n_in + t4*n_out^2 + t5
cavagna2026_llama31_8b_h100.hardware: NVIDIA H100, single GPU, in-flight batching (max_batch_size 1024)
cavagna2026_llama31_8b_h100.provenance: Memory-and-FLOPs fitted parameters, 'Determining Energy Efficiency Sweet Spots in Production LLM Inference' (https://arxiv.org/html/2602.05695v1). Applies to a batched datacentre deployment, not a batch-1 home GPU.

caravaca2025_opt30b_a100.label: Caravaca et al. 2025 marginal rates (OPT-30B, A100)
caravaca2025_opt30b_a100.provenance: Marginal rates derived from P1/P2/P3 per-prompt Wh in 'From Prompts to Power' (https://arxiv.org/html/2511.05597): (P2-P1)/800 and (P3-P1)/800 tokens. Reference for decode/prefill ratio only.
